## Foreign Buying Drives KOSPI Over 3% Higher, Samsung and SK Hynix Lead Korean Semiconductor Rally

A foreign-driven KOSPI surge concentrated in semis can be a leading indicator for global semiconductor demand sentiment; for a PM with Korean semi exposure or DRAM/HBM-adjacent names, this is a directional tailwind worth monitoring alongside the SK Hynix bond-market exit signal in the same session.

- KOSPI surged over 3%, led by South Korean semiconductor stocks.
- Foreign investor buying identified as the primary driver of the move.
- Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix named as primary beneficiaries.
- Signals risk-on sentiment returning to Korean tech and broader EM semiconductor names.
- Foreign inflows into Korean semis may reflect improving global demand cycle expectations.
